name: driftwave
description: A look-before-you-act loop for Claude Code with a verification spine: check what's there, what's asked, and the gap — freeze the success criteria, do the work, and let computed verdicts (PASS/FAIL/NULL/CERTIFIED_NULL, fail-closed) say what happened. H₀ persistent homology clustering (real, with a seeded decoy control); the higher 'sheaf'/'H₁' layers are topology-inspired LLM heuristics, stamped not_acceptance. Domain-agnostic via feature-channel adapters. Guided by five axioms: NO_AVERAGING, UPWARD_FLOW, WAYPOINT_ROUTING, SHAPE_OVER_COUNT, ADAPTIVE_SCALE.
